name: Falcon Hill Camp
description_short: Weekly camps at Holy Child School at Rosemont for boys and girls 3 to 13: Falcon and Kinder Camps for young children, Fun Camp sports and games for rising grades 1 to 7, plus one week theater, science, literacy, math and study skills camps. Open to all families.
refund_policy_summary: A $100 non-refundable deposit per camper per week at registration; no refunds or credits for cancelled weeks after March 22, 2026, and none for absences.
notes: 2026: nine weekly sessions, June 8 to July 31 and August 24 to 28; which camps run varies by session. Camp hours 9 am to 3 pm with half day options. Falcon Camp (ages 2.8 to 3) and Kinder Camp (4 to 6): $375 half day, $450 full day. Fun Camp (rising 1 to 7): $275 half day, $425 full day. Theater Camp $500; academic and specialty half day camps $300 to $450. Extended care 8 to 9 am and 3 to 4:30 pm as add ons; prices not on the page. $25 early bird discount per camp. Bring lunch and snack. June field hockey and August sports camps are for Holy Child students only. 2027 not posted yet.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page.
